segments.text:
Verſ. 34.
By the ſame way hee came ſhall he returne, and not come into this Citie, ſaith the Lord.

WEe haue ſaid before, that to returne by the ſame vva•, ſignifies, To goe his way without performing any thing; as wee vſe to ſay in our common prouerbe; Hee went as wiſe as he came, when one returnes without doing that which he came for, and is preuented in all his enterpriſes. To confirme this, he addes that the Lord hath ſaid it. For no ſooner hath he (which cannot lie) ſpoken, but we ought forthwith to receiue and imbrace his word; and that no leſſe then if all impediments being taken away, we ſaw the effect by and by to take place.
